pages: Foreground: Caius, a nine-year-old, dark hair cut straight and short to his jaw, a blue wool coat with the sleeves turned back and the collar up on wet cobbles, boots too small. Middle distance: a cobbled lane down to a slipway, an open five-bar gate. Background: a whitewashed wall, a grey sea. Flat grey light.

Foreground: a hand with a chalk stub against the kitchen shutter, a pale column of notches and strokes up the boards. Middle distance: Caius, a nine-year-old, dark hair cut straight and short to his jaw, a blue wool coat with the sleeves turned back and the collar up at the shutter. Background: the lane, the sea. Low early light.

Foreground: Caius, a nine-year-old, dark hair cut straight and short to his jaw, a blue wool coat with the sleeves turned back and the collar up at a scrubbed table, a plate of bread before him. Middle distance: the kitchen shutter open, the chalk notches up the boards. Background: a whitewashed wall, the lane. Flat morning light.

Foreground: a grey and brindle lurcher with a white throat and a white eyebrow over the left eye, sitting in the open five-bar gateway, nose down the coast road, ears up. Middle distance: flattened straw where he has dropped it. Background: the lane, a slipway, a grey sea. Flat first light, and nobody else there.

Foreground: Caius, a nine-year-old, dark hair cut straight and short to his jaw, a blue wool coat with the sleeves turned back and the collar up on the wet cobbles of the gateway, bread in one hand. Middle distance: a grey and brindle lurcher sitting beside him, nose down the road. Background: the lane, whitewashed wall. Flat grey light.

Foreground: the empty gateway, one flattened place in the straw, the kennel door open behind. Middle distance: Caius, a nine-year-old, dark hair cut straight and short to his jaw, a blue wool coat with the sleeves turned back and the collar up standing at the gate with bread. Background: the lane, a grey sea. Flat grey light.

Foreground: Caius, a nine-year-old, dark hair cut straight and short to his jaw, a blue wool coat with the sleeves turned back and the collar up on wet shingle under the cliff. Middle distance: a grey and brindle lurcher lying with his head on his paws, facing the water. Background: black rock, the point above, open sea. Overcast light.

Foreground: Caius, a nine-year-old, dark hair cut straight and short to his jaw, a blue wool coat with the sleeves turned back and the collar up on the worn turf at the headland edge. Middle distance: the curve of the bay, two headlands, the black rock shoulder cutting the road. Background: four miles of open water. Grey rain light.

Foreground: Caius, a nine-year-old, dark hair cut straight and short to his jaw, a blue wool coat with the sleeves turned back and the collar up in the rain, arm raised, pointing down the road. Middle distance: the road to the whitewashed wall, the black rock shoulder across it. Background: the bay, grey sea. Rainlight.

Foreground: wet cobbles and the shadow the open five-bar gate throws across them. Middle distance: Caius, a nine-year-old, dark hair cut straight and short to his jaw, a blue wool coat with the sleeves turned back and the collar up sitting in the gateway, hands on his knees, mouth shut. Background: the whitewashed wall, the lane. Dull rain light.

Foreground: a leather collar dripping in one hand, the five bars of the gate beside it. Middle distance: Caius, a nine-year-old, dark hair cut straight and short to his jaw, a blue wool coat with the sleeves turned back and the collar up sitting in the gateway in the rain. Background: an open cottage doorway. Flat grey light.

Foreground: a hand swinging a leather collar, the wet road running away from the gate. Middle distance: Caius, a nine-year-old, dark hair cut straight and short to his jaw, a blue wool coat with the sleeves turned back and the collar up walking down it. Background: the black rock headland, a low white boat far out at sea. Rainlight.

A weaving shed in a river valley, with nobody in it. Foreground: a bolt of green wool cloth on a loom beam, a row of nine wooden pattern blocks along the frame. Middle distance: a row of looms down the shed, a bench of shuttles. Background: beams of dusty window light, the valley and river outside. Warm afternoon light.

A loom seen close, with nobody in the shed. Foreground: warp threads stretched across the reed at a shallow slant, a wooden set square against them, three pattern blocks pulled half out of their slots in a row of nine. Middle distance: cloth coming off the frame. Background: dusty window light. Flat daylight.

Foreground: a cart standing in the lane outside the shed, its shafts down in the mud. Middle distance: Pell, the buyer, seated at a bare table with a heavy book open before him, four bolt ends stacked beside it. Background: a row of looms, beams of dusty window light. Cool daylight from the open door.

Foreground: Rois, a fourteen-year-old, dark hair in one braid over her right shoulder, a green wool apron over a grey dress with the sleeves pushed to the elbow standing at her own loom, shuttle in hand. Middle distance: green cloth coming off the frame. Background: loom after loom, a door ajar. Beams of dusty window light.

Foreground: an old right hand with a burnt place on it laid flat on a warp thread. Middle distance: Ansel, sixty-one and thin, white hair cut short, a leather apron the colour of dark honey at the loom frame. Background: a row of looms, a row of nine wooden pattern blocks along it. Beams of dusty window light.

Foreground: Rois, a fourteen-year-old, dark hair in one braid over her right shoulder, a green wool apron over a grey dress with the sleeves pushed to the elbow at her loom with the bolt in her hands. Middle distance: a diagonal break across it like cracked ice, a second further along. Background: loom after loom, dusty light. Flat daylight.

Foreground: Rois, a fourteen-year-old, dark hair in one braid over her right shoulder, a green wool apron over a grey dress with the sleeves pushed to the elbow at her loom, one finger on the cloth. Middle distance: a tally board with notches along its edge. Background: four thin breaks in the first span. Window light.

Foreground: a thumb pressed on a thin diagonal break in green cloth, the cloth turned edge on to the light. Middle distance: Ansel, sixty-one and thin, white hair cut short, a leather apron the colour of dark honey bent over the frame with his hand still on it. Background: a row of looms, shafts of dusty window light.

Foreground: Rois, a fourteen-year-old, dark hair in one braid over her right shoulder, a green wool apron over a grey dress with the sleeves pushed to the elbow at a stone bench, hands on the cloth. Middle distance: two bolts side by side, one sound, one with a break. Background: the mill wall, the river, bolts stacked. Flat daylight.

Foreground: cloth off the long loom crossed by twenty-two thin diagonal breaks. Middle distance: Rois, a fourteen-year-old, dark hair in one braid over her right shoulder, a green wool apron over a grey dress with the sleeves pushed to the elbow at the frame, a shuttle in her hand. Background: a dark shed, one lamp. Lamplight.

Foreground: an old right hand with a burnt place on it, hanging open at a man's side. Middle distance: Ansel, sixty-one and thin, white hair cut short, a leather apron the colour of dark honey standing with both hands still. Background: a row of looms, a row of nine wooden pattern blocks. Beams of dusty window light.

Foreground: worn boots on a wet path, weir stones with thin water running over them. Middle distance: Ansel, sixty-one and thin, white hair cut short, a leather apron the colour of dark honey walking down the bank with his hands empty. Background: a mill wheel and the millrace, the valley above. Low sun on the water.

Foreground: Rois, a fourteen-year-old, dark hair in one braid over her right shoulder, a green wool apron over a grey dress with the sleeves pushed to the elbow on the bank looking at the water. Middle distance: the short river running over weir stones. Background: a sluice board half up, the mill, the valley. Low evening sun.

Foreground: Rois, a fourteen-year-old, dark hair in one braid over her right shoulder, a green wool apron over a grey dress with the sleeves pushed to the elbow with one hand flat on a folded bolt. Middle distance: the cloth opened out, a diagonal break through it. Background: looms down the shed, bolts stacked. Beams of dusty window light.

Foreground: an old right hand with a burnt place on it, held out palm up and open. Middle distance: Ansel, sixty-one and thin, white hair cut short, a leather apron the colour of dark honey standing at the end of the loom row. Background: looms, the nine pattern blocks, dusty window light. Flat daylight.

A market square in Ashlund. Foreground: a long bolt of green cloth unrolled on a stall board, eleven more stacked behind. Middle distance: Sennet Fisk, a girl of sixteen, hair loose, folding another length of cloth at the stall. Background: an open square, a low stone wall. Autumn light on the flags.

A weaving shed in Ashlund with nobody in it. Foreground: two looms side by side and a warped chest between them. Middle distance: a bare bench, a shuttle on the floor, no cloth on either beam. Background: a low window and a grey river. Flat winter light through the window.

Foreground: Rois, a fourteen-year-old, dark hair in one braid over her right shoulder, a green wool apron over a grey dress with the sleeves pushed to the elbow at the frame facing the room. Middle distance: nine wooden pattern blocks along the frame. Background: a row of looms, benches, pegs on the wall. Noon light from high windows.

Foreground: an open hinged brass angle measure laid on a bench. Middle distance: Rois, a fourteen-year-old, dark hair in one braid over her right shoulder, a green wool apron over a grey dress with the sleeves pushed to the elbow with her hands held apart. Background: a loom, a bench of shuttles, dusty light. Noon light.

Foreground: a square boot planted on the shed boards. Middle distance: Corven, the master weaver, standing in the middle of the floor with his arms at his sides. Background: two looms, a row of nine wooden pattern blocks, an open door. Flat daylight from the door.

Foreground: a heavy book lying closed on a cart tailboard beside two stacked bolts of green cloth. Middle distance: Pell, the buyer, standing at the cart shafts with a hand flat on the closed book. Background: the lane up the valley, the shed roof, hills. Cool autumn daylight.

Foreground: a shawl folded over an old woman's forearms, a door stuck behind her. Middle distance: Asta, white hair, a shawl over her shoulders in the doorway of the back shed. Background: the long loom bare in the shed, an empty cottage yard beyond. Flat spring light.

Foreground: a boy's hands on the shuttle and the beater of a loom. Middle distance: a boy of sixteen from the mill standing at the frame. Background: a row of nine wooden pattern blocks, the shut shed door bolted. One shaft of light from a high window.

Foreground: Rois, a seventeen-year-old, dark hair in one braid over her right shoulder, a green wool apron over a grey dress with the sleeves pushed to the elbow at a wash bench with a basket at her feet. Middle distance: wet stones by the river, sheets on a line. Background: the mill wall, the valley above. Flat grey daylight.

Foreground: an old woman's forearms folded over a shawl. Middle distance: Asta, white hair, a shawl over her shoulders in the half-open doorway of the back shed. Background: through the gap a warp on a loom frame, dusty window light. Flat spring light from the open door.

Foreground: Rois, a seventeen-year-old, dark hair in one braid over her right shoulder, a green wool apron over a grey dress with the sleeves pushed to the elbow with a shuttle down into her open hand. Middle distance: warp threads running up the frame behind her. Background: the half-open door, the valley beyond. Spring light.
